podcast.body: This song, featuring Jay-Z, was the winner of the 2007 Billboard Song of the Summer. Many critics cite it as the "pivot point" for the Song of the Summer concept, a "sweltering jam that popularized the notion that one hot weather hit could clear the field." Ironically, the song's theme is not about sunshine but "rain gear." "2007's song of the summer, umbrella from Rihanna featuring J. Z."
